description.zh: 在 Operit 侧边栏中承载本机 Linux Runtime 运行的 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面，并提供服务状态与启停控制。
description.en: Embeds DeepSeek Harness Web from the local Linux runtime in the Operit sidebar and provides service status and lifecycle controls.
description.default: Embeds DeepSeek Harness Web from the local Linux runtime and provides service lifecycle controls.

description.zh: 查询、启动、重启和停止本机 DeepSeek Harness Web 服务。
description.en: Inspects, starts, restarts, and stops the local DeepSeek Harness Web service.
